scope: Retained RecBole time-aware model math; independent strict-panel prefix-time adaptation. Not reproduction of original sampled-candidate paper results.

adaptation.name: TiSASRecModel
adaptation.source: MIT RecBole-TRM TiSASRec; pinned commit, not original-paper numerical reproduction
adaptation.padding: valid-first right padding; item index 0; gather length-1
adaptation.time_protocol: Caller: only already-truncated visible history; minimum positive visible chronological gap, or 1; floor(abs(ti-tj)/scale), clip 256; zero for same bucket and padding pairs; no target time.
adaptation.preserved: TimeAware attention/layer/encoder and FeedForward AST; initialization; upstream forward computation; inherited causal mask and gather.
adaptation.score_all: Unmasked full-catalog logits including padding index 0; caller masks index 0 and evaluation seen items except target.
